title: Smart Intent Router with Confidence Scores
description: Added classifyWithConfidence() to LLMService that returns { type, intent, confidence } with 0-100 score. Updated UnknownIdentificationWorkflow to use confidence-based classification — contacts below 60% confidence get clarifying questions instead of being mis-classified.
features: classifyWithConfidence() returns JSON with type, intent, and confidence score
Confidence threshold at 60% — below triggers clarification
Intent extracted alongside type classification (single LLM call)
JSON parsing from LLM response with regex fallback
